page_title: STR 2-0 MNT | Strasbourg v Montpellier 09/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Jeremy Stinat is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+3' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Montpellier was in an offside position.
90+1' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) peels away from his marker to receive a lofted pass, but sends his rocket of a shot just wide of the left post from inside the box.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
89' The Montpellier players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
88' Substitution. Sekou Mara (Strasbourg) on for Emanuel Emegha.
87' Othmane Maamma (Montpellier) is shown a deserved yellow card for saying too much to the referee.
84' Liam Rosenior has decided to make a change. Abdoul Ouattara (Strasbourg) replaces Sebastian Nanasi.
83' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Diego Moreira walks off the pitch to be replaced by Eduard Sobol (Strasbourg).
83' Khalil Fayad (Montpellier) gets a shot away from distance, but wasn't really set to take it and fires well wide of the left post.
83' Sebastian Nanasi (Strasbourg) takes the corner kick, but Benjamin Lecomte reads it well and stops the effort.

82' Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball is out of play. Strasbourg will have a chance to score from a corner.
80' The referee had an easy-decision to make. A yellow card is given to Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
80' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball.
79' Nicolas Pays (Montpellier) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
77' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Andrey Santos (Strasbourg) was quite harsh and Jeremy Stinat didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
75' Jean-Louis Gasset has decided to substitute Abdoul Bamo Meite and he is replaced by Jordan Ferri (Montpellier).
75' Guela Doue (Strasbourg) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Valentin Barco.
73' Abdoul Bamo Meite (Montpellier) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jeremy Stinat had an easy-decision to make.
71' Felix Lemarechal (Strasbourg) has a sight of goal and shoots towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper makes a superb save.
69' 2 - 0 Sebastian Nanasi (Strasbourg) receives a delightful pass inside the box and smashes a low shot into the bottom left corner. What a clinical finish!
67' Andrey Santos (Strasbourg) blows an opportunity as he sends a rebound from just outside of the box narrowly wide of the left post.
65' Strasbourg failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
63' What a big chance! Nicolas Pays (Montpellier) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and skies the ball well over the bar.
63' Here comes a substitution. Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) is brought on as a substitute for Andy Delort.
62' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Nicolas Pays (Montpellier) will replace Tanguy Coulibaly.
62' Becir Omeragic (Montpellier) is substituted due to injury. Jean-Louis Gasset gives a chance to Othmane Maamma.
61' Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
59' Becir Omeragic (Montpellier) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
56' Andrey Santos (Strasbourg) meets a cross inside the box, but his header is blocked by an opposing player.
54' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Strasbourg.
53' Diego Moreira (Strasbourg) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
53' Felix Lemarechal (Strasbourg) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner, but Benjamin Lecomte has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
51' Montpellier couldn't find the way to score from a long-range free kick as Djordje Petrovic (Strasbourg) leaped high and intercepted a cross.
48' The resulting corner from Valentin Barco (Strasbourg) is cleared.

48' Strasbourg are playing some nice combination football, sending it precisely from player to player, but a defender shows good anticipation and ends the move with a good block. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Strasbourg.
46' Half-time substitution. Jean-Louis Gasset decided to make a change. Modibo Sagnan (Montpellier) is replaced by Yael Mouanga.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' 1 - 0 Goal! Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) fires the rebound into the middle of the goal after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:0.
45+2' Diego Moreira (Strasbourg) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
44' Tanguy Coulibaly (Montpellier) latches onto a loose ball inside the box but slams it well wide of the left post.
43' One of the players from Strasbourg times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
42' Andrey Santos (Strasbourg) tries his luck with and strikes the ball towards goal from long-range, but it is blocked by one of the defenders.
40' Sebastian Nanasi (Strasbourg) latches on to a sweet cross into the box and misses with a header way wide of the left post.
37' Diego Moreira (Strasbourg) has a good chance to get on the scoresheet and fires the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar.

35' Tanguy Coulibaly (Montpellier) gets into a good shooting position. He wins some space for himself and drills a long-range daisy-cutter towards the middle of the goal. His good effort is, however, superbly saved by Djordje Petrovic!
34' A corner kick by Montpellier is thwarted by the well prepared Djordje Petrovic (Strasbourg).

33' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Montpellier comes to nothing. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Montpellier will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
33' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal from a mid-range free kick, but the ball is blocked by the defensive wall. It will be a corner kick for Montpellier.
31' Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
30' Some great play by Theo Sainte-Luce (Montpellier) ends with a shot on the edge of the box low towards the middle of the net, but Djordje Petrovic sees it all the way and makes a comfortable save.
29' Strasbourg couldn't find the way to score from a long-range free kick as Benjamin Lecomte (Montpellier) leaped high and intercepted a cross.
28' A clumsy foul by Tanguy Coulibaly (Montpellier) and Jeremy Stinat blows his whistle.
24' Sebastian Nanasi (Strasbourg) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
23' Strasbourg control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
20' Djordje Petrovic makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded towards the left-hand post by Andy Delort (Montpellier) after a cross from the side.
19' Jeremy Stinat shows a yellow card to Modibo Sagnan (Montpellier) for his blatant foul.
19' Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) latches on to an accurate pass inside the box and shoots towards goal, but it goes well wide of the right post.
16' The resulting corner from Sebastian Nanasi (Strasbourg) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
16' Felix Lemarechal (Strasbourg) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Good work from Strasbourg as they win a corner.
14' Tanguy Coulibaly (Montpellier) hits a rasping drive from inside the box after latching onto a lofted pass, but it's straight at Djordje Petrovic and he makes a comfortable save.
12' Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
10' Andy Delort (Montpellier) latches onto a lofted pass near the penalty spot, but sends his header miles wide of the right post.
9' The corner from Sebastian Nanasi (Strasbourg) is hurriedly cleared.

9' A snap shot by Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom left corner, but Benjamin Lecomte produces a good save to thwart him. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Strasbourg.
7' Valentin Barco (Strasbourg) blazes a shot from a long-range free kick and the ball ends somewhere in row Z. The ball goes out of play and Montpellier will have a goal kick.
6' Modibo Sagnan (Montpellier) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
6' The Strasbourg players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
2' Diego Moreira (Strasbourg) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Montpellier will have the kick-off.
Jeremy Stinat will referee today's match.
